guidance.when: Candidate NDA language supports the current hypothesis.
guidance.inspection: Resolve definitions and cross-references, then require every actor, modality, act, object, quantifier, condition and time element. Merely related or materially narrower text fails.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote original operative spans plus every definition or cross-reference needed to prove all elements.

guidance.when: Candidate NDA language appears opposed to the current hypothesis.
guidance.inspection: Require an express negation or an operative rule making the whole proposition impossible. Respect quantifiers: an exception leaving some instances does not negate an existential claim; silence is not conflict.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote original conflicting spans and linked definitions sufficient to exclude the complete proposition.

guidance.when: The hypothesis concerns what qualifies as Confidential Information.
guidance.inspection: Build the complete inclusion rule. For nda-1, every qualifying route must require express identification; for nda-2, every included category must be technical; for nda-3, at least one oral route must qualify. Preserve all conditions and exceptions.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the governing definition, list introduction and relevant items, together with disclosure-mode qualifiers.

guidance.when: The NDA addresses onward disclosure by the Receiving Party.
guidance.inspection: Find an authorization covering employees for nda-5 or third parties, including advisers or agents, for nda-7. Conditional need-to-know or confidentiality safeguards may limit permission; duties imposed on recipients alone do not grant it.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the authorization, covered recipient category, conditions and incorporated definitions.

guidance.when: The NDA addresses similar information obtained independently of the protected disclosure.
guidance.inspection: For nda-12, require an independent-development permission or exclusion; for nda-13, require a third-party-source permission or exclusion. Verify that the route does not depend on prohibited use or disclosure.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the provenance rule and every condition defining independence or lawful third-party receipt.

guidance.when: The NDA regulates copies or information at or after termination or a return request.
guidance.inspection: Distinguish a duty to return or destroy some information for nda-16, authorization to make a copy for nda-17, and an express post-disposition retention exception for nda-20. Do not infer retention merely from incomplete deletion mechanics.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the triggering event, affected materials, operative duty or permission, and applicable archive, backup or legal-retention exception.

guidance.when: The NDA contains an operative restriction on conduct.
guidance.inspection: Match the prohibited act precisely: use beyond stated purposes for nda-4, disclosure of the agreement's existence or negotiation for nda-10, reverse engineering covered objects for nda-11, or solicitation of covered representatives for nda-18.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the prohibition, its protected object or person, purpose or timing limits, and material exceptions.

guidance.when: The NDA addresses disclosure compelled by law, regulation or process.
guidance.inspection: Require a Receiving-Party notice duty triggered by compelled disclosure. Record advance-notice, promptness and legality qualifiers; do not treat a mere right to notify as a duty.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the compelled-disclosure trigger, mandatory notice language and all limiting conditions.

guidance.when: The NDA disclaims rights conveyed by disclosure or by the agreement.
guidance.inspection: Require language denying the Receiving Party a license, ownership interest or other right in Confidential Information; a reservation of the Disclosing Party's rights may qualify only if it necessarily denies such a grant.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the operative no-grant language and the defined property or information it covers.

guidance.when: The NDA specifies consequences of expiration or termination.
guidance.inspection: Identify at least one agreement obligation expressly continuing, assigned a duration beyond termination, or necessarily requiring post-termination performance. A clause preserving only accrued rights is insufficient.
guidance.evidence_requirement: Quote the termination provision and the surviving obligation, duration or incorporated section.
